caption: The drawing depicts a long, rectangular wooden table with a smooth, medium brown surface and slightly rounded edges. The tabletop is supported by four thick, turned legs, each with visible detailing and a wider, ornamental section in the middle. These legs connect at the bottom to a rectangular frame made of matching wood, creating a lower support level that mirrors the shape of the tabletop. The frame sits just above the floor and is joined to the legs at each corner. The entire table is rendered in shades of brown, with subtle variations indicating shadows and highlights. The background is a plain, light beige or off-white, which provides contrast and isolates the table as the only object in the composition.
title: Refectory Table
